verdict.rationale: Built-in AI for banking operations is a fair question for a banking-as-a-service platform with an ops console, so the axis applies. The evidence shows centralized operational workflows, case notifications, KYC/KYB verification and enhanced due diligence. Nothing in the pack mentions built-in AI, natural-language transaction search, drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes only make the docs and API machine-readable; they are not product AI features.
